rule.name: LoggerForOtherClass
rule.message: This logger is created for a class with a similar name (same last word, or same first two words and the same number of words) other than the one that declares it, usually a copy-paste slip, so its log lines carry the wrong category: the level settings of this class do not apply and searches for its logs miss them. Use the enclosing class literal (private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Orders.class)), MethodHandles.lookup().lookupClass(), or getClass() for an instance logger. An exception fits when a facade class deliberately logs as its public type.

property.name: xpath
property.value: //FieldDeclaration/VariableDeclarator/MethodCall [@MethodName = ('getLogger', 'getLog', 'get', 'getFormatterLogger')] [*[1][(self::TypeExpression/ClassType/@SimpleName, self::AmbiguousName/@Name) = ('LoggerFactory', 'LogManager', 'Logger', 'LogFactory', 'Log', 'Logging', 'System')]] [ArgumentList[@Size = 1]/*[1][self::ClassLiteral or (self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('getName', 'getCanonicalName')][*[1][self::ClassLiteral]])]] [let $named := ArgumentList/*[1]/descendant-or-self::ClassLiteral/*[1]/@SimpleName, $own := ancestor::*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration or self::AnnotationTypeDeclaration], $inFile := ancestor::CompilationUnit//*[self::ClassDeclaration or self::EnumDeclaration or self::RecordDeclaration or self::InterfaceDeclaration]/@SimpleName, $parents := $own/(ExtendsList | ImplementsList)/ClassType/@SimpleName, $words := function($n) { tokenize(replace($n, '([a-z0-9])([A-Z])', '$1 $2'), ' ') }, $a := $words($own[last()]/@SimpleName), $b := $words($named) return exists($named) and not($named = ($inFile, $parents)) and not(contains($own[last()]/@SimpleName, $named) or contains($named, $own[last()]/@SimpleName)) and ($a[last()] = $b[last()] or ($a[1] = $b[1] and $a[2] = $b[2] and count($a) = count($b)))]
